title: DR1 lists each saved animal by species name with a labelled column per identifier; the frontend labels the row "Animal 1" and runs the identifiers into one cell

finding.frontend: Saved animals appear as a summary list, one row each, keyed "Animal 1", "Animal 2" and so on, with every identifier the user supplied joined into a single value cell — "Ear tag: UK123456789012" on fe-animal-identification-saved and both rows of fe-animal-identification-at-maximum. Identifiers left blank are omitted from the string rather than shown as empty, and a record with none reads "No identifier provided". The list has no header row, so nothing on the page names the columns. It sits above the entry form rather than below it. The markup is at src/server/app/sets/live-animals/journeys/linear/features/commodities/animal-identification/_identification-card.njk:12-24 and the joined string is built in the same feature's identifier/summary.js:9-19.
finding.prototype: DR1 renders the saved animals as a table with a header row — "Animal" followed by one heading per identifier the commodity defines, so a cattle line reads Animal / Ear tag / Passport. Each body row is keyed with the species name and the animal's number, "Syncerus spp. 1", and gives each identifier its own cell, empty ones included. It is in app/views/partials/animal-identification-saved-animals.html:1-28, with the rows built at app/routes.js:1788-1800. While the species is still being entered the table sits below the identifier inputs and the in-card save button (app/views/animal-identification-details.html:130-132); once every animal is complete the entry form goes and the table stands alone (:101-104). DR1's capture was taken before any animal was saved, so this table is unphotographed on the DR1 side.
finding.difference: Rebuild the saved-animal list in _identification-card.njk:12-24 as a table headed by the identifier labels for that commodity, one column per identifier, and key each row with the species name and index instead of "Animal N". Move it below the entry form at the same time, where DR1 puts it. The identifier labels are already available from the scoped field list the entry form uses, and identifier/summary.js:9-19 stops being the source of the display value — it would still be needed for the check-answers cards, which read the same joined string. The Remove action stays on the row.
finding.falsifiedBy: Saving two DR1 cattle animals and seeing a single joined value cell per row rather than an Ear tag column and a Passport column.
finding.verification: Opened fe-animal-identification-saved and fe-animal-identification-at-maximum, screenshots and rendered DOM — the rows read "Animal 1 | Ear tag: UK123456789012 | Remove" inside a govuk-summary-list with no header row — and dr1-animal-identification-details, which was captured before any animal was saved. Read _identification-card.njk:12-24, identifier/summary.js:9-19, app/views/partials/animal-identification-saved-animals.html whole and the row builder at app/routes.js:1788-1800. Ran the falsifier from the source, since neither side photographs a saved DR1 animal: DR1's header row is "Animal" plus one heading per identifier field, each value gets its own cell, and getSavedAnimalsForSpecies labels every row `${speciesLabel} ${index + 1}`, so two cattle animals read "Syncerus spp. 1" and "Syncerus spp. 2" across an Ear tag column and a Passport column. CORRECT.
finding.correction: Understated by one difference in the same block, which is recorded and folded into the same change rather than raised separately, because it is one edit to one list. The two sides put the saved animals on opposite sides of the entry form. The frontend renders the list above the counter — _identification-card.njk:12-24 comes before the counter at :29 — where DR1 renders it below the identifier inputs and the in-card save button (app/views/animal-identification-details.html:130-132), moving it to the top of the panel body only once the species is complete and there is no entry form left (:101-104). finding.frontend, finding.prototype and finding.difference now say so.
